summary: Final regression test of Estimate Workbench Save/Open/Refresh/PDF workflow (v1.0). All 13 review-request items PASS on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Fresh localStorage → added 2 items from Commercial domain → renamed estimate → Save button enabled → localStorage persisted (estimate_number EST-260714-L03M, name 'TEST Regression Estimate', 2 items) → URL updated with ?id={uuid} → hard browser refresh preserved name + items → Open dropdown lists 'New Estimate' + saved estimate row → clicking New resets to 'New Estimate' 0 items → clicking saved row re-loads it (name/items intact) → Export PDF triggers jsPDF download 'TEST Regression Estimate_2026-07-14.pdf' → Clear button empties list with confirm dialog. Sidebar 'Estimating' menu expands with 4 sub-items (Estimate Workbench, Production Library, Assemblies, Templates) with proper data-testids. Production Library Explorer at /app/estimating/library renders 24 DOMAINS / 58 CATEGORIES / 367 STANDARDS. Mobile: full-screen library modal, Save/Open dropdown & New Estimate button all work; mobile-estimate-name-input NOW EXPOSED (was flagged MEDIUM in iteration_30 — FIXED). Mobile save also persists to localStorage.

ui_bugs.issue: toast.success('Estimate saved!') fires but is not always visually detectable to automated tests — could be sonner auto-dismiss timing (default ~4s) shorter than the 2s wait we used. Functionality is confirmed working via localStorage persistence; UX-wise a longer toast duration or an inline 'Saved • {time}' badge might be clearer.

Pressing Enter in [data-testid='edit-price-input'] did not commit the price change in our test (qty went from 1→2 but price remained $0). It may require clicking an explicit Save/checkmark button. Recommend wiring Enter key to submit and Escape to cancel for keyboard accessibility.

Direct-standard rows (rendered when a standard has no service_category_ids — the majority of the seed data) still have NO data-testid, unlike category-nested standards which have [data-testid=library-item-${id}]. Carry-over from iteration_30. Currently only reachable via div.cursor-pointer selector which is fragile.

integration_issues.flow: Post-login workspace bootstrap (pre-existing carry-over from iteration_26)
integration_issues.issue: Console errors: '[AppLayout] Workspace context error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' and '[CommandCenter] Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch' still appear at /app/command-center on every login. Does NOT affect the Estimate Workbench (production-library endpoints work fine). Not a Save/Open regression.

issues: All seeded standards still have $0.00 unit_price (per README) — the estimate visually renders '1 × $0.00 = $0.00' rows and the summary Total is $0.00 unless the user edits prices manually. Consider a subtle hint 'Click to set price' on rows with zero price.
'Send to Client' button (desktop LiveSummary) still fires toast.info('Send to client coming soon') only. Either disable, hide, or label 'Coming soon' badge to avoid user confusion.
Seeded domain list still contains both 'Multi-Family' and 'Multifamily' as separate top-level domain folders — data-hygiene duplicate that should be resolved at the seed level.

critical_code_review_comments: EstimateWorkbench.jsx uses browser confirm() in createNewEstimate + handleClearEstimate — prefer shadcn AlertDialog for consistency (also blocks Playwright unless a page.on('dialog') handler is registered).

EstimateWorkbench.jsx: `calculations` is memoized both here AND inside LiveSummary.jsx (duplicated useMemo of the same formula). Pass `calculations` prop down (already done for MobileWorkbench) to eliminate drift risk.

EstimateWorkbench.jsx line 312 (`useEffect [] on mount`): missing dependency for `fetchLibraryData`, `fetchEstimates`, `searchParams`, `loadEstimate` — currently intentionally suppressed but should be documented with an eslint-disable comment.

estimatePdfGenerator.js line 399: footer prints 'Page 1 of N' but page number is hardcoded to '1'. Multi-page estimates will show 'Page 1 of 3' on every page. Use doc.getNumberOfPages() + setPage(i) loop.

LibraryBrowser.jsx: directStandards render block (lines 293-315) is a near-duplicate of the category-nested render block (lines 260-285). Extract into a shared <StandardRow/> subcomponent with a data-testid so both branches remain in sync and testable.

EstimateWorkbench.jsx saveEstimate() saves ALL estimates to a single localStorage key with no size limit — 5MB browser cap will be hit at ~1000 estimates. For MVP fine, but plan for backend snapshot migration soon.

EstimateWorkbench.jsx unsaved-changes tracker (isInitialLoad ref) only marks unsaved after mount, but loadEstimate() also runs post-mount and could inadvertently flip hasUnsavedChanges to true when only lineItems.length is 0→N. Verified working in this test but the coupling is fragile.
MobileWorkbench.jsx line 160: tax label is still hardcoded 'Tax ({taxRate}%)' — good, correctly interpolated (was flagged in iteration_30; verified fixed).
EstimateBuilder inline edit: onKeyDown for Enter/Escape not wired — recommend adding for keyboard UX.
